crowdwisdom_creative_directions.title: Noise‑to‑Signal Transformation
crowdwisdom_creative_directions.description: Show a chaotic, overlapping chart feed (representing market noise) that gradually filters into a single clear signal line powered by CrowdWisdomTrading’s professional trader insights. Voiceover emphasizes 'cutting through the noise to see what really matters.' Ends with a CTA to download a free market‑intelligence brief.

crowdwisdom_creative_directions.title: Trader‑Testimonial Mini‑Doc
crowdwisdom_creative_directions.description: Feature short, authentic clips of professional traders explaining how they use CrowdWisdomTrading to validate ideas and avoid false moves. Intercut with before/after trade examples. Concludes with an offer: 'Get a free 7‑day trial of our intelligence feed.'

crowdwisdom_creative_directions.title: Interactive Challenge
crowdwisdom_creative_directions.description: Present viewers with a quick, timed quiz: 'Can you spot the real breakout among these three charts?' After they choose, reveal the answer and explain how CrowdWisdomTrading’s insight would have guided them. Offer a free strategy guide for those who sign up.
